commit-message.note: Written for Spotcraft (adapted from vinskiano): Conventional Commits, summary at most 50 characters; the agent commits and pushes its branch, the user merges.

github-workflows.note: Written for Spotcraft: conventions of .github/ (SHA pins, permissions, environments, OIDC).

patches: allowed-tools narrowed from `npx|pnpm dlx|bunx shadcn-svelte@latest *` to `pnpm --filter @spotcraft/ui exec shadcn-svelte *`: never pre-approve an unpinned CLI; the CLI is pinned in packages/ui
`npx shadcn-svelte@latest` replaced with the pinned command throughout; Spotcraft note added (shared packages/ui, `add -y`, move CLI-added deps to dependencies)
`npx @sveltejs/mcp` replaced with `pnpm exec svelte-mcp`: the CLI is pinned as a root devDependency instead of downloaded unpinned at run time
Description: dropped the pointer to a `svelte-file-editor` subagent, which Spotcraft doesn't have
Description and a Spotcraft note: the modules run on OpenTofu (`tofu fmt`, `tofu validate`)
`allowed-tools: Bash(curl:*), Bash(jq:*), Bash(head:*)` removed: pre-approving any curl is too broad
Spotcraft section added: query the unpublished port 8428 over SSH with the container's wget
